## Why DAEOL

**Why DAEOL | SEO, AEO & GEO Together**

Customers research with Google and AI tools. DAEOL runs SEO, AEO and GEO as one strategy so your brand is found and cited in both.

Search Is Changing. Your Visibility Should Too.

Customers now research products and compare services in both traditional search engines and AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. A complete visibility strategy covers both.

### Traditional — SEO
Technical website foundations, search intent and keyword relevance, helpful well-structured content, internal linking and organic visibility.

### AI-Powered — AEO & GEO
Clear answer-focused content, better structure and context, relevant well-supported brand information, and improved potential to be understood by AI search.

#### Two discovery channels, one strategy
People still search on Google, but more questions are now answered directly by AI tools that summarise the web and name a few brands. If your business is missing from those answers, you are missing from a growing share of the decision.
DAEOL treats search engines and answer engines as one system. The same clear, well-structured, consistent information serves both.

- Clear answers to the questions customers really ask
- Technical foundations that crawlers and AI systems can read
- Consistent brand facts across your site and the wider web

#### Honest by design
No agency can control what ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity says, and we won't pretend otherwise. We improve the signals these tools rely on, measure selected prompts over time, and report plainly what changed and what didn't.

## Services

**AEO, GEO & SEO Services | DAEOL**

AI visibility audits, answer engine optimization, generative engine optimization, technical SEO and schema, content and monthly reporting.

AEO, GEO and SEO services built to work together

DAEOL connects your website, content and brand signals into one visibility strategy built around the questions your customers actually ask.

### 01 — AI Visibility Audit
Review selected AI-search prompts and customer questions, examine competitor visibility, identify website and content gaps, and provide prioritized recommendations.

### 02 — Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
Improve answer-focused page structure, create clear responses to relevant questions, optimize FAQs and service pages, and clarify existing content.

### 03 — Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
Improve content context and structure, strengthen topical coverage, and keep brand information consistent so AI systems can interpret it.

### 04 — Technical SEO & Schema
Technical reviews, crawlability and indexability checks, internal linking, structured-data implementation, and performance prioritization.

### 05 — Answer-First Content & Authority
Customer-question research, helpful informational and comparison content, brand entity consistency, and ethical digital PR.

### 06 — Measurement & Reporting
Baseline AI visibility checks, prompt and competitor monitoring, organic performance reviews, monthly reports and recommendations.

#### How the services fit together
Most businesses don't need six separate projects. The audit shows where you stand, AEO and GEO fix how your content is understood, technical SEO removes blockers, and reporting proves what moved.
You can start with the free audit and only commit to the parts that matter for your market and budget.

- Start: free audit to find the biggest gaps
- Build: answer-first pages, schema and entity clean-up
- Grow: authority content, monitoring and monthly reviews

#### What you actually receive
Every engagement ends in tangible work: rewritten and restructured pages, implemented structured data, a prioritized roadmap and a monthly report in plain language.

## Platforms

**AI Search Platforms We Optimize For | DAEOL**

How DAEOL helps brands show up in Google Search, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google Gemini and Microsoft Bing.

Show up where your customers ask for answers

DAEOL helps you evaluate and improve your presence across the discovery platforms your customers use. Visibility varies by query, location, platform, model and time.

### G — Google Search
Traditional search now blends AI-generated overviews with classic results. Strong SEO foundations still matter.

### AI — ChatGPT
Clear, well-structured brand information helps it reference your business accurately.

### P — Perplexity
An answer engine with cited AI summaries. Answer-focused content and clear sourcing can improve how your brand appears.

### ✦ — Google Gemini
Consistent brand information and helpful content support more accurate representation.

### B — Microsoft Bing
Technical SEO and structured data help both classic and Copilot results find your pages.

We don't claim control over these platforms, guaranteed placements, or official partnerships.

#### Each platform behaves differently
Google blends AI overviews with classic rankings. ChatGPT and Gemini compose answers from what they have learned and retrieved. Perplexity shows its sources prominently. Bing feeds Microsoft Copilot.
That is why we test selected prompts per platform, in your target market, instead of relying on one score.

- Prompts chosen from real customer questions
- Results checked by market, since answers vary by location
- Changes tracked over time, not as a single snapshot

## Process

**Our Process: Audit to Action | DAEOL**

DAEOL's four-step process: discover, audit and prioritize, optimize, then measure and improve.

How DAEOL works: from audit to action

Every engagement follows four steps: discover, audit and prioritize, optimize, then measure and improve.

### 01 — Discover
Understand the business, audience, website, competitors and the customer questions that matter most.

### 02 — Audit & Prioritize
Assess technical SEO, content quality, AI-search opportunities and brand information. Create a prioritized plan.

### 03 — Optimize
Implement agreed improvements to content, page structure, technical foundations and brand information.

### 04 — Measure & Improve
Review agreed metrics, repeat selected visibility checks, and refine the strategy using available data.

#### What to expect in the first 90 days
Weeks one and two are discovery and the audit. Weeks three to six are the first optimization sprint on your highest-value pages. After that we measure, repeat prompt checks and refine.
Visibility in AI answers moves over months, which is why the Basic plan has a 3-month minimum.

- Kick-off: goals, audience, competitors
- Audit: technical, content, AI citation check
- Sprint: priority pages, schema, entity facts
- Review: monthly report and next priorities

## Industries

**AI Search Optimization by Industry | DAEOL**

AEO, GEO and SEO for SaaS, professional services, marketing, e-commerce, healthcare and local services.

AI search optimization for your industry

Every industry has different discovery challenges. We tailor AEO, GEO and SEO to the questions your audience asks.

### SaaS & Technology
Complex products are hard for AI to summarize. Answer-focused documentation and comparison content help engines represent your product clearly.

### Professional Services
Trust and expertise must be obvious. Clear authority signals and structured service pages help you surface in advisory queries.

### Marketing & Creative
Agencies get oversimplified or misattributed. Defined service categories and consistent brand info help AI represent your full offering.

### E-commerce & Retail
Product pages compete with AI buying advice. Structured product data and decision-stage content help you appear in comparisons.

### Healthcare & Wellness
Accuracy and trust are critical. Clear, authoritative, well-structured content helps reputable providers surface.

### Home & Local Services
Local queries blend maps, AI summaries and reviews. Local SEO, consistent business info and review signals strengthen visibility.

Illustrative use cases, not verified client results.

#### Same method, different questions
A SaaS buyer asks for comparisons and integrations. A homeowner asks who is nearby and trusted. A patient asks about safe, reputable providers. We map the questions that matter in your industry and build answers around them.
The examples above are illustrative use cases, not client results.

## FAQ

**AEO & GEO FAQ | DAEOL**

Answers about AEO, GEO, AI search optimization, timelines, guarantees, pricing and reporting.

Frequently asked questions

Clear answers about AEO, GEO, AI search optimization and how DAEOL works.

### What is AEO?
Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is the practice of making your content answer-focused so AI-powered search tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google Gemini can understand and reference it accurately.

### What is GEO?
Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) improves your content's context, structure and brand information consistency so generative AI tools can interpret your business accurately.

### How is GEO different from traditional SEO?
Traditional SEO helps pages rank in search results. GEO helps AI tools understand and represent your brand inside the answers they write. They complement each other, and we run them together.

### Can DAEOL guarantee that ChatGPT or another AI tool will mention my business?
No. Nobody controls what an AI platform says, and no one can honestly guarantee a mention. We improve the signals these tools rely on and report what changes.

### How long does AEO and GEO take to show results?
Usually a few months, not days. Timing depends on your starting point and competition, which is why Basic Answer has a 3-month minimum.

### Do I need SEO before investing in GEO?
Solid technical SEO makes your content easier for both search engines and AI tools to find and understand. We check your foundations in the audit and fix gaps as part of the work.

### What is included in the free audit?
A website audit covering technical, content and structure basics, an AI citation check across selected prompts, an initial competitor visibility review, and prioritized next steps.

### How much do your services cost?
Audit Check is free. Basic Answer is $498/month with a 3-month minimum. Premium is $1,399/month on a 6-month term or $1,899/month on a 3-month term. Prices are in USD.

### Will I receive monthly reports?
Yes. Every month you receive a report on what we did and what changed, including selected AI-answer visibility observations and search performance.

### Do you work with businesses in Canada, the UK and Australia?
Yes. We serve businesses in the USA, Canada, the UK and Australia.

#### Still have a question?
Send it with your free audit request or email team@daeol.si and we'll answer in plain language.
